_meta.note: V0.1 and V0.2 artifacts are immutable. This file contains the frozen human-approved calibration only.

NET-002.human_note: Raised to 65 MAD/ch for better F2/F3 market alignment and stronger artisan economics

NET-013.human_note: Raised to 250 MAD to fully reflect both-faces scope and stronger market positioning

NET-014.human_note: Raised to 300 MAD — consistent with both-faces scope and cleaner market positioning

worker_count.definition: 1 individual cleaner working 1 hour = 1 cleaner-hour. Two cleaners working 3 hours = 6 cleaner-hours.
worker_count.disclosure_requirement: Future estimator UI must display: number of cleaners, estimated duration, total cleaner-hours, calculated price, minimum-floor note if applicable.
worker_count.ambiguous_wording_forbidden: 65 MAD/heure without per-cleaner qualifier is FORBIDDEN in any FIXEO surface.

anti_double_charge.rule: NET-001 minimum visit is a FLOOR, never an additive fee

MODEL_A.label: Standard Residential Cleaning
MODEL_A.disclosure: Must be disclosed to client before booking — cleaner arrives without products or equipment.

MODEL_C.label: Professional / Specialist Cleaning
MODEL_C.note: Professional products and specialist equipment included in price. No separate billing for consumables or equipment.

mattress_face_semantics.consumer_facing_rule: FIXEO canonical price = one mattress cleaned on both faces. Per-face pricing is NOT exposed to the client.
mattress_face_semantics.source_ambiguity_note: V0.1/V0.2 evidence documented that sources used differing per-face vs per-mattress conventions. The human decision freeze resolves this: NET-013 = 250 MAD (both faces), NET-014 = 300 MAD (both faces). Historical evidence is preserved as-is in v0.1.json.
mattress_face_semantics.historical_integrity: Do not rewrite V0.1 evidence sources to pretend they all used the same convention.

levels.STANDARD: Normal residential soiling — standard price applies
levels.HEAVY: Materially abnormal soiling declared at booking — requires pre-agreed scope and price
levels.POST_CONSTRUCTION: Construction residue — NET-030 scope and pricing
levels.SPECIALIST: Mold (structural), biohazard, sewage, infestation, fire/smoke — ROUTE_TO_SPECIALIST

on_site_discovery_protocol: 2. IDENTIFY the objective condition with specificity
3. EXPLAIN the condition to the client
4. DECLARE it is outside the standardized FIXEO price
5. STATE revised scope and/or quote requirement
complexity_policy.forbidden: Artisan-controlled multipliers (1.2×, 1.5×, 2×, etc.) without separately researched, calibrated, and human-approved rates.
complexity_policy.no_silent_price_increase: No standardized price may silently increase at point of delivery.

geographic_policy.city_evidence_status: Casablanca-specific evidence exists in sources.v0.1.json and evidence.v0.1.json as evidence only — it does NOT produce city multipliers.

modifier_policy.status: ALL NULL — none approved in this phase

worker_economic_floor.classification: FIXEO_POLICY — not a Moroccan legal minimum wage, not a statistically established market floor
worker_economic_floor.rationale: 40 MAD/ch net reflects the minimum economically viable rate for a Moroccan urban cleaner covering their own transport. Below 35 MAD/ch net, intervention economics are unviable.

floor_verification_at_approved_rate.note: At 65 MAD/ch × 3h = 195 MAD, minimum floor of 200 applies. Net at minimum: (200 × 0.80) - 25 = 135 MAD / 3ch = 45 MAD/ch — above floor.

standard_cleaning_scope.label: Contrat nettoyage standard FIXEO — NET-001 / NET-002
included: Dépoussiérage des surfaces accessibles (meubles, rebords, prises, interrupteurs)
Aspiration des sols (tapis, moquette, carrelage, parquet)
Nettoyage standard de la salle de bain: lavabo, douche/baignoire, WC, miroir
Nettoyage standard de la cuisine: surfaces plans de travail, extérieur appareils, extérieur micro-ondes
Nettoyage de la table et des chaises
standard_cleaning_scope.scope_note: Excluded specialist services must NEVER be silently absorbed into NET-001/002 billing.

deep_clean_scope.label: Contrat grand nettoyage FIXEO — NET-004
included: Vitres intérieures accessibles (dans les limites contractuelles définies)
Dégraissage cuisine approfondi (four intérieur, hotte, plans de travail)
excluded: Vitres en hauteur (> 2m sans accès direct)
deep_clean_scope.operating_model: Typically 2 cleaners. Professional deep-clean scope. Products and specialist equipment artisan-supplied.

sofa_cleaning_scope.label: Contrat nettoyage canapé FIXEO — NET-010 / NET-011
included: Injection-extraction ou procédé professionnel de nettoyage textile équivalent
Produits et équipement professionnel fournis par l'artisan
excluded: Taches incrustées sévères (surcharge requiert accord préalable du client)
Cuir, velours, daim, alcantara (tarif ajusté — accord préalable requis)

mattress_cleaning_scope.label: Contrat nettoyage matelas FIXEO — NET-013 / NET-014
mattress_cleaning_scope.canonical_unit: Un matelas complet — les 2 faces nettoyées
included: Injection-extraction ou vapeur selon type de tissu
Produits et équipement professionnel fournis par l'artisan
excluded: Taches biologiques sévères (surcharge requiert accord préalable)
Matelas très dégradé (tissu déchiré ou en fin de vie)

post_construction_scope.label: Contrat nettoyage après travaux FIXEO — NET-030
included: Élimination poussières fines de chantier (sols, surfaces, rebords)
Lavage et nettoyage des sols (carrelage, parquet, marbre)
Nettoyage des vitres standards (traces de peinture légères, colle légère)
Produits et équipements industriels fournis par l'artisan
excluded_and_escape_conditions: Accès en hauteur > 2m sans accès direct
post_construction_scope.escape_rule: Escape conditions MUST NOT silently increase the 18 MAD/m² rate. Artisan must STOP, declare, and obtain client approval before proceeding.

post_construction_stress_test.duration_formula: max(area/10, 3) hours per worker, 2 workers standard
post_construction_stress_test.confidence_note: LOW confidence evidence (2 external sources). Human field verification with artisans strongly recommended before production launch.

client_facing_disclaimer: Prix indicatif FIXEO — tarif réel confirmé avec l'artisan avant intervention.
